text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and Io are out shopping.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒に買い物に出かけている
{0}とイオ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee. I'm happy you were able to come with me to run
errands. It kind of feels like a little date.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
{0}君と一緒に買い物なんて、
うれしいわ。
なんだかデートみたい。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, isn't this the light from last time?
Ahh, it's so bright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
これって、
あの時の光……？
わっ、まぶしい……！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Aieee!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}, you're awake?
Thank goodness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、{0}君！
気がついたのね。
よかった～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what happened?
You and your friends were horsing around,
and you fell down a flight of stairs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覚えてる？
他の男の子たちとふざけていたら、
階段から落ちちゃったのよ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I've been so worried. I was afraid you might not open your
eyes again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このまま目を開けないんじゃないかって、
すごく心配したんだから……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
No, don't try to get up!
You have to lie down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、まだ動いちゃダメよ！
安静にしてなくちゃ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: B-besides, when you shift around like that, it tickles.
choice_data_list: Am I... lying on your lap?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それに……
もぞもぞ動かれると、
くすぐったいわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You were sleeping very restlessly, though.
Is this uncomfortable?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
寝苦しそうだったから……
ダメだった？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
What? No, no!
Don't go into the light, or your eyes will stay closed forever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ！　
ダメよ！
天国に行っちゃったら、
目がさめなくなっちゃう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You didn't mean it literally?
So you're comfortable, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
そういう意味じゃないの？
よかったってこと？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee. That's good.
I'm glad you think I'm comfy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、よかった。
そう言ってもらえるとうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
All right, we'll stay like this a little longer.
Just until you've settled down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
もう少し……
落ち着くまで、
こうしてましょうね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to be tense. No one else is here.
Lie down, relax, and let me take care of everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫よ。
他には誰もいないわ。
二人っきりだから、
いっぱい甘えていいのよ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Your finger's bleeding.
You must've scraped it when you fell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ！
{0}君、指から血が……
転んだ時に、すりむいちゃったのね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Let me see it.
A scratch like this usually just needs a little lick.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと見せて。
……これくらいの傷なら、
舐めておけば大丈夫ね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: *lick*
text_block_list.orig_text: はむ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. That should do it.
Uh-oh. {0}, are you still hurting?
Your face is beet red.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん！　
これで大丈夫。
あれ？　
どうしたの、{0}君？
顔が真っ赤……

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 1
text_block_list.text:
We come to check up on you,
and this is what we find?
text_block_list.orig_text:
様子を見に来てみたら……
お前なにしてんだ！

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 2
text_block_list.text:
Not only are you lying in Miss Io's lap,
she's sucking on your finger?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちの伊緒ちゃんに膝枕させたうえに、
ムリヤリ指をしゃぶらせるなんて！

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 1
text_block_list.text:
You dirty dog. I sentence you to death!
Get him, guys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
許せねぇ！　
極刑だ！
お前ら、やっちまうぞー！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}?
Where are you going?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
{0}君！
どこ行くの！？

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 2
text_block_list.text:
After him!
Don't let him get away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃がすなー！
追えーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha. Well, this is a relief.
If he's got the energy to run around with his friends,
he must be fine now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
よかった。
あれだけ元気があれば、
もう平気ね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Well, what'd you think of my present?
Did you enjoy your dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだった？　
あたしからのプレゼント！　
いい『夢』見られた？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I crafted that dream based off Io's and your memories,
but who'd have guessed you'd play it like that?
I had a lot of fun watching how things unfolded.
text_block_list.orig_text:
以前のあんたとイオの記憶を元に作った『夢』なんだけど、
今のあんたはこんな行動をとるのね。
あたしも見てて楽しかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's it for now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: {0}, are you awake?
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}君、目がさめた？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
No, I just woke up a second ago myself.
I had a weird dream again.
What about you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
私もついさっきまで寝てて……
また不思議な夢を見たの。
{0}君も？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You dreamed I was nursing you back to health?
Then they were the same again. No matter how many times
this happens, it still feels otherworldly, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が看病する夢？
やっぱり同じ夢みたい……
何回もあるなんて、
ほんと不思議ね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, we were going out to buy supplies for the
Lucent Academy nurse's office, weren't we? Maybe that's why
we had that dream. Let's hurry over to the store.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そういえば、
保健室の備品を買いに行くんだったわね？
……だから、
あんな夢見ちゃったのかしら？
じゃあ、
早くお店に行こうか？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And {0}?
Be careful. Don't fall and get hurt like you did in our dream.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ、気を付けて、{0}君。
夢みたいに転んで怪我とかしないようにね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As she returned to running errands with
{0}, Io secretly hoped they'd have
identical dreams again soon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と買い物に向かいながら、
また同じ夢が見たいと願うイオであった。
